Aviatrix.description: Aviatrix is a fast-paced crash game where players bet on a plane's flight while the multiplier continuously increases. Players must cash out before the plane crashes to secure winnings, with multipliers reaching up to 10,000x.
what_makes_it_unique: Aviatrix features a unique experience-based progression system where players build and customize their own aircraft. As they earn experience through gameplay, they unlock new cosmetic upgrades while enjoying a transparent 97% RTP experience.

Aviatrix Second Chance.description: Aviatrix Second Chance is an aviation-themed crash game where players bet on a rising flight multiplier and attempt to cash out before the aircraft crashes.
what_makes_it_unique: Aviatrix Second Chance introduces a signature Second Chance feature that allows selected players to continue after the initial crash. It also shares player progression, achievements, and loyalty status with the original Aviatrix, creating a unified gaming ecosystem.

Aviatrix Fruits.description: Aviatrix Fruits is a classic fruit-themed video slot featuring a traditional 5-reel, 3-row layout with 10 paylines. It combines simple slot gameplay with vibrant visuals inspired by the Aviatrix universe.
what_makes_it_unique: Aviatrix Fruits stands out by integrating customized Aviatrix aircraft into its Scatter symbols, creating a unique visual identity that changes dynamically throughout each gaming session.
